title: Ashbury Rewards Points Purchase Terms
content:
**1. Own account, own payment.** A member may buy Ashbury Rewards points for their own account, paying with their own card; buying is the member's own decision and payment.

**2. Account age.** Points may be bought only once the account has been open for the tier's minimum number of days since enrolment. The age of the account is counted in whole calendar days from the enrolment date, which is day zero; a purchase on the day the minimum is reached is allowed. The enrolment date on the membership is the authority.

**3. Frequency.** A member makes at most one purchase per calendar day.

**4. Refunds.** Purchased points are not refundable when the tier's setting makes them non-refundable.

**5. Account status.** Points are bought only for a membership whose status is active.

## Retired clauses

> **No longer in force.** The clause "Points are bought in multiples of the purchase increment at the price per 1,000 points, before any sales tax" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for the price of a purchase. The tier's increment and price figures themselves remain the tier's figures.

> **No longer in force.** The clause "The points bought in one calendar year, counted with the points purchased in the calendar year and including the purchase being made, may not exceed the annual purchase cap; a request beyond the cap is reduced to the remaining allowance or declined, never split across another member's account" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for the purchase allowance.

## Boundary cases on account age (hypothetical dates, minimum of 30 days)

| Enrolment date | Purchase date | Day count | Allowed under term 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2026 | 31 March 2026 | 30 | Yes — the day the minimum is reached |
| 1 March 2026 | 30 March 2026 | 29 | No |

## Points of judgement

- A second purchase on the same calendar day as an earlier purchase is not made.
- A suspended or closed membership cannot buy points.

superseded_clauses: Points are bought in multiples of points_purchase_increment at points_purchase_price_per_1000_usd for each 1,000 points, before any sales tax.

The points bought in one calendar year, counted with loyalty_msr_purchased_ytd and including the purchase being made, may not exceed points_purchase_annual_cap; a request beyond the cap is reduced to the remaining allowance or declined, never split across another member's account.
